pupil of Marion Finlaison

It is not certain that the Ethel Luke, pupil of Finlaison, referred to by CMY in 1879 is this person, but she seems the most likely candidate.

She was the daughter of the Rev.

William Henry Colbeck Luke, Vicar of St.

Matthias, Earls Court, and she married (1895) George Herbert Munn.
